# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_STAGE2_KEEPER_TOP

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The strategy attempts to capture bearish momentum via tighter entry filters (volume, candle body, signal confirmation) and adjusted exit parameters (smaller TP1, tighter catastrophic stop, profit lock activation). The edge exists in exploiting short-term mean reversion after overextended moves, but the current parameter set fails to capture J's winner days effectively.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Requires volume ≥ 1.1× 20-bar average, candle body ≥ 0.02 cents, ≥2 confirming signals (min_stars=2), strike 2 OTM put (strike_offset=2), and price breaking above the open (require_break_above_open=true).  
**Exit:** Catastrophic stop at -6% premium (premium_stop_pct=-0.06), TP1 at +40% premium (tp1_premium_pct=0.4) selling 2/3 position (tp1_qty_fraction=0.667), runner target at +300% premium (runner_target_pct=3.0), profit lock armed immediately (profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0) with stop offset +0.08 (profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.08).
